summary: Iter16 regression pass (frontend-only) after Profile.js + CalendarPage.js refactors and Sentry integration. ALL targeted regressions PASS. Landing renders correctly (h1=1, h2=10, body text 8191 chars, 0 pageerrors — PaperPlaneTilt regression from iter15 is fixed). Login + sidebar nav all 7 routes work. Profile page shows all 5 sections (Subscription, Notifications, Email Digest, Email Config, Data Export, Account Info). Calendar page renders + Add Event modal opens with Title input, All-day checkbox, Start/End time fields, Cancel + Create buttons. Team Calendar tab works. Admin /admin/audit shows Audit Logs UI with 4 filters + Export CSV button. Admin /admin/users shows Users table with plan filter chips (All/Free/Pro/Business) and per-row actions. Sentry SDK correctly NOT initialized — 0 network requests to sentry.io domains, 0 console errors mentioning Sentry init, ErrorBoundary wrapping in App.js confirmed with GlobalErrorFallback containing data-testid='global-error-fallback'.
critical_code_review_comments: instrument.js correctly guards Sentry.init with truthy DSN check and avoids duplicate init on hot reload — good defensive pattern
App.js GlobalErrorFallback is bilingual (EN+AR) and resetError-aware — meets the requirement
Profile.js cleanly delegates to 5 section components in /components/profile/* — refactor verified behaviourally identical
CalendarPage.js delegates modal to /components/calendar/CalendarEventModal.js — modal fields and buttons render exactly as before
seed_data_creation: None — verified UI only, did not submit Create Event to avoid polluting calendar data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both refactors (Profile + Calendar) verified visually + behaviorally identical to pre-refactor. Sentry monitoring confirmed inert when REACT_APP_SENTRY_DSN/SENTRY_DSN are unset. Landing page is healthy after the iter15 PaperPlaneTilt fix. No follow-up testing required for this iteration unless main agent makes further changes.
